'''pointy-eared green dude Oldies But Goodies''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 5 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|The Signal|JP-L-thesignal.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|A New Secret Base|TA-L-anewsecretbase.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MPG dude LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

So I'm sitting here at college, and I find someone else who plays this silly game known as Star Wars CCG.  Currently I'm working on getting him back into the game.  This is his first deck in, like, five years.  I think it has some potential, personally.  If you can, keep in mind that this deck will stay classic throughout editing.  Any ideas to make it faster or better?

== Notes ==

* No objective (the author asks which objective to play); starts The Signal, A New Secret Base and Hoth: Main Power Generators.
* Posted 'Wedge Antilles, Rogue Squadron Leader' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader (no 'Rogue Squadron Leader' card exists; the closest title).
* Posted Space Slug Belly dested Big One: Asteroid Cave Or Space Slug Belly; Civil Disorder x2 is unmarked, so it is the printed card.

== Strategy ==

Like I said, this is an extremely classic deck.  Any changes that would be conducive to make this deck even more playable under the restrictions of classic would be great.  What objective could he play?  Anything that should be cut or replaced?  Thanks for your help!

PEGD
